saas.request: Audit this report-generation SaaS for coding agents that should create and retrieve reports through a public API. Produce a prioritized plan in the conversation without modifying anything. Use supplied source and bounded loopback GETs only.

source.routes.ts: POST /reports requires reports:write; validates {title:string}; returns 201 {id:string,status:'queued'}; invalid body returns 422 {code:'invalid_title'}; GET /reports/:id requires reports:read; absent id returns 404 {code:'report_not_found'}.
